title: finding(app-shell): useAutoRunCreate strips ?runAction=create_environment even when the toolbar has no create action, destroying the deep link unrecoverably
body:
Observation recorded while investigating #3803 (whose own premise did not survive measurement — see that card). Filed separately because it is a **different** defect from #3803's hypothesis and is out of that card's scope.

## Fact

`packages/app-shell/src/environment/EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx` arms `useAutoRunCreate` from the *presence of any toolbar action*, not from the presence of the create action:

```
const autoRunCreate = useAutoRunCreate(toolbarActions.length > 0 ? ctaKind : null);
```

`toolbarActions` is filtered only by `locations.includes('list_toolbar')`. So when the toolbar renders actions but **none of them is `create_environment`**, `shouldRun` still becomes true, and the effect strips `runAction` from the URL — while `renderedActions` attaches `autoTrigger` to nothing, because that only happens for `a.name === CREATE_ACTION`.

Measured on `origin/main` (sha `bfdf3d419`) with the real `action:bar` + `action:button` runner, a toolbar carrying a single non-create action and `?runAction=create_environment` in the URL:

```
no-create-action: urlParam=null execute=0
```

The param is gone and nothing ran. Because consumption is modelled as "strip the URL", the signal is **unrecoverable** — a reload cannot retry the deep link, which is exactly the "one-shot, so refresh does not re-open" property working against the user here.

## Why it may matter

This is the #844 welcome-page flow ("Create your environment" CTA deep-linking into the list). The user lands on the list, no dialog opens, and the URL no longer carries the intent.

Reachability in a real deployment is **not** demonstrated and is the open question for triage: it needs a toolbar that has at least one `list_toolbar` action but no `create_environment`. Two candidate paths, neither confirmed against real cloud metadata:

- the cloud does not serve `create_environment` for this org/plan while still serving other toolbar actions;
- `create_environment` declares `requiredPermissions` the caller lacks, so `action:bar`'s capability gate (ADR-0066 D4) filters it out of the rendered bar — note the toolbar's own `toolbarActions` is computed *before* that gate, so the two disagree by construction.

The second path is the interesting one: the arming condition and the rendering condition are evaluated by different code with different filters, so they can diverge whenever the bar drops an action the toolbar counted. Filed as observation-class (`finding`, no `pm:queue`) per objectstack#4949 — severity self-assessed at filing time is unreliable, so triage should grade it.

## Sketch of a fix direction (not implemented)

Arm on the create action specifically rather than on `toolbarActions.length` — gate `useAutoRunCreate` on whether `toolbarActions` actually contains an action named `create_environment`, so the URL is only consumed when there is something to trigger. Whether the capability-gate divergence should also be closed (toolbar and bar applying the same filter) is a separate design question.

## Related

- Landing file: `packages/app-shell/src/environment/EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx` (`useAutoRunCreate`)
- Deep-link flow origin: #844
- Investigated under: #3803
- Searched open issues first (`runAction` / `EnvironmentListToolbar` / deep link strip) — no duplicate. Unassigned.
